text: The open carriage, a comfortable landau
why: ¶50-51 mention an open carriage outside and a comfortable landau in which they drive off.
¶51 states that Colonel Ross leaned back with his hat tilted over his eyes.

text: Thursday evening, driving in the landau through Tavistock
why: Holmes said in ¶13 that it is Thursday morning, ¶47 says they reached Tavistock in the evening, and ¶51 has them rattling through the town in the landau.

text: What Inspector Gregory reports on the drive
why: ¶51 says Gregory poured out a stream of remarks about his case, and that his theory was almost exactly what Holmes had foretold, which ¶46 already set out. The label names the account without revealing new content.
